name: VisTouch
summary: 机器人滑动接触场景下同步采集视觉、触觉力和接触音频的大规模多模态数据集。
summaryEn: A large-scale synchronized vision, force-tactile, and contact-audio dataset of robotic sliding interactions.
scale: Synchronized clips, frames, tactile force, audio, and material labels
scaleZh: 同步片段、视频帧、触觉力、音频和材料标签
licenseZh: 数据采用 CC-BY-4.0，代码采用 MIT
access: Official repository provides metadata, loaders, benchmarks, and download instructions
accessZh: 官方仓库提供元数据、加载器、基准和下载说明
verdict: 适合学习接触动力学和跨模态物理状态的同步数据
verdictEn: Synchronized data for contact dynamics and cross-modal physical-state learning
wmNote: 视觉、声音和力反馈的同步信号有助于接触状态预测。
wmNoteEn: Synchronized vision, sound, and force signals support contact-state prediction.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - liangnjupt/VisTouch: A large-scale synchronized vision–touch–audio dataset of robotic sliding contact · GitHub
evidence.statement: Robot sliding-contact episodes pair video and audio with time-varying tactile-force trajectories; no inferred motor-action labels.
